hero.title: Vascular and cranial neurosurgery of high complexity
hero.description: Specialized evaluation of cerebral aneurysms, arteriovenous malformations, cavernomas, Moyamoya disease, cerebral revascularization, and complex cranial tumors.

sobreMim.heading: The Best Neurosurgery and Neurological Care
sobreMim.paragraph: Trust me to provide the best treatment and transform your life with excellence and dedication, in a humane and exclusive way — my greatest commitment to my patients and their families.

quote.text: Neurosurgery is an art, and it is an honor to be able to practice it. To work in a field of such profound importance — giving patients back their lives — is far more than a profession; it is a great privilege.
quote.attribution: So says Dr. Hugo Leonardo Doria-Netto, MD, PhD, whose gift in medicine is recognized as a blessing from God.

brain.heading: Essential Care for Your Neurological Health
brain.paragraph: Experience world-class neurological treatments combined with the humane, exclusive, and personalized care that is Dr. Hugo Doria's hallmark.

especialidades.heading: My Specialties
especialidades.description: Dr. Hugo Doria offers advanced neurosurgical treatments, including cerebral aneurysms, arteriovenous malformations, brain and spinal tumors, Moyamoya disease, trigeminal neuralgia, hemifacial spasm, and cerebral revascularization.
